    input [7:0] a, b,
    output [7:0] and_out,
    output [7:0] or_out,
    output [7:0] xor_out
);

assign {and_out[7], and_out[6], and_out[5], and_out[4], 
        and_out[3], and_out[2], and_out[1], and_out[0]} = 
    {a[7], a[6], a[5], a[4], a[3], a[2], a[1], a[0]} & 
    {b[7], b[6], b[5], b[4], b[3], b[2], b[1], b[0]};

        or_out[3], or_out[2], or_out[1], or_out[0]} =

    {b[7], b[6], b[5], b[4], b[3], b[2], b[1], b[0]};

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input resetn,
  input [1:0] byteena,
  input [15:0] d,
  output reg [15:0] q
);

always @(posedge clk or negedge resetn)
begin
  if (!resetn) begin
    q <= 16'd0;
  end else begin
    if (byteena[1] || !byteena[0]) begin
        if (byteena[0] && !byteena[1]) begin
            q[0] <= d[0];
        end
        else if (!byteena[0] && byteena[1]) begin
            q[1] <= d[1];
        end
        else begin
            if ((byteena[0] || byteena[1]) && d == 0) begin
                q[0] <= d[0];
                q[1] <= d[1];
            end
            else if (!byteena[0] && byteena[1] && d != 0) begin
                q[1] <= d[1];
            end
            else if (byteena[0] && !byteena[1] && d != 0) begin
                q[0] <= d[0];
            end
            else begin
                q[0] = d[0];
                q[1] = d[1];
            end
        end
    end
  end 
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input shift_ena,
  input count_ena,
  input data,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

always @(posedge clk) begin
  if (shift_ena) begin
    q <= {q[3], data}; // Shift left with data in LSB
  end else if (count_ena) begin
    q <= q + 1; // Increment
  end
end

endmodule
